units.export_conversion: export_and_bake converts joint/mesh/translation data x100 in memory and writes the FBX in centimetres with unit scale factors of 1 (see docs/build_and_import_instructions.md)

conventions.blender: right handed, +Z up, character faces -Y, character left = +X, ground z = 0, origin between the feet
conventions.unreal: left handed, +Z up, mesh faces +Y, character left = +X (component space = Blender (x, -y, z) * 100); the character actor rotates the mesh component by yaw -90 so the actor faces +X
conventions.bone_local_blender: Y along the bone (head->tail), Z towards the listed z axis, X = Y x Z
conventions.bone_local_unreal: Unreal bone local axes are the Blender axes mapped by (x, -y, z): the bone runs along local -Y
conventions.rotation_signs: Blender bone-local rotation (axis a, angle t) equals Unreal bone-local rotation (axis (ax,-ay,az), angle -t); quaternion (w,x,y,z)_blender -> (w,-x,y,-z)_unreal
conventions.root: single root bone "root" at the origin with identity rest orientation; pelvis is its child

procedural_rules.half: local rotation = slerp(identity, driver local rotation relative to its rest pose, amount)
procedural_rules.untwist: child of driver: local rotation = inverse(twist of driver local rotation about the bone axis) * amount
procedural_rules.twist: sibling of driver under the same parent chain: local rotation = twist of driver local rotation about the bone axis * amount
